name: Scream
summary: Donna Diego is bonded to a yellow symbiote spawned in the Life Foundation’s attempts to copy Venom. She is a symbiote antagonist associated with Venom more than with Peter Parker’s central rogues’ gallery.
relation: Symbiote antagonist tied to Venom. Not a core Peter Parker rogue.
firstAppearance: A Life Foundation symbiote in the early-1990s Venom comics. This record does not pin one issue number.
creators: The Life Foundation symbiotes come from the Venom: Lethal Protector era. A single creator credit is not fixed here.
powers: A symbiote that can extend hair-like tendrils and fight with a host’s amplified body.
origin: Donna Diego is one of several hosts the Life Foundation bonds to symbiote offspring.
